questions.question: What is the global reduction percentage in Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) over the past 30 years?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**42%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India’s Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) has declined by an impressive 83% over the past 30 years, while the global reduction during the same period was 42%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The global reduction in Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) over the past 30 years is 42%.**
 
• **India’s MMR reduction stands at 83%, nearly doubling the global decline.**
 
• **The Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) also saw a global decline of 55%, whereas India’s IMR reduction was 69%.**
 
• **The success in reducing MMR and IMR is attributed to government healthcare initiatives and infrastructural improvements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Key Government Initiatives__

 __
 
• **Special Newborn Care Units (SNCUs):** 1,087 units established across hospitals to improve maternal and child health.
 
• **Newborn Stabilisation Units (NBSUs):** 2,868 units set up to provide emergency care for newborns.
 
• **Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY):** A scheme promoting institutional deliveries for maternal health improvement.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA):** Provides free prenatal check-ups for pregnant women.
 
 
 
• Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR)__
 
 
• MMR is defined as the number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births.
 
• It is a key indicator of a country’s healthcare system and maternal health services.

questions.question: Which organisation has published the "Global Drought Outlook 2025: Trends, Impacts, and Policies"?

options.text: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __O**rganisation for Economic Co-operation and Development**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **​The Global Drought Outlook 2025, released by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)**, highlights the increasing frequency, severity, and impacts of droughts worldwide, emphasizing the urgent need for robust policies to adapt to a drier future.
 
• **Rising Frequency and Severity: **40% of the world’s land area is now experiencing more frequent and severe droughts.
 
• **Economic Costs:** The economic cost of droughts is increasing by 3%–7.5% annually, with a projected 35% increase in drought-related economic losses by 2035.
 
• **Soil Moisture and Groundwater Decline:**
 
 
• Since 1980, 37% of global land has experienced significant soil moisture loss.
 
• 62% of monitored aquifers show declining groundwater levels.
 
 
 
• **Disaster Impact:** Droughts, though accounting for only 6% of natural disasters, are responsible for 34% of all disaster-related deaths and exacerbate issues like poverty, inequality, displacement, and migration, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa.
 
• **Agricultural Impact:** Crop yields can decline by up to 22% due to drought, threatening global food security.

questions.question: Regarding the recently published status of vaccination coverage in India and the world by The Lancet, which of the following options is *incorrect*?

options.text: India is the highest contributor to unvaccinated children.
​Despite the high absolute number, India’s immunisation coverage rates for many vaccines are above global averages.
India accounted for 1.4 million of the 15.7 million zero-dose children globally.
More than half of the world’s unvaccinated children live in eight countries including India.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India is the highest contributor to unvaccinated children.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **The Lancet** recently published data on global vaccination coverage, highlighting the status of zero-dose children and immunization rates worldwide.
 
• India accounted for **1.4 million of the 15.7 million zero-dose children globally**, making it a significant contributor but not the highest globally.
 
• **Nigeria was the highest contributor to unvaccinated children. India ranked second after Nigeria.**
 
 
• **​Hence, Option 1 is *INCORRECT*.**
 
 
 
• India's **immunization coverage rates for many vaccines** remain above global averages despite its large population.
 
• **More than half of the world's unvaccinated children** reside in eight countries, including India, as per the report.
 
• These eight countries are:
 
 
• First - Nigeria
 
• Second - India
 
• Third - Democratic Republic of Congo
 
• Fourth - Ethiopia
 
• Fifth - Somalia
 
• Sixth - Sudan
 
• Seventh - Indonesia
 
• Eighth - Brazil
 
 
 
• The claim that "India is the highest contributor to unvaccinated children" is **incorrect**, as other countries also contribute significantly to this number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zero-dose children:**

 
 
• These are children who have not received even the first dose of basic vaccines such as DPT (Diphtheria, Pertussis, and Tetanus).
 
• They are a critical focus area for global health organizations due to their vulnerability to preventable diseases.
 
 
 
• **Immunization coverage in India:**
 
 
• India has improved its vaccination efforts under initiatives like **Mission Indradhanush**.
 
• Programs aim to reach underserved and hard-to-reach populations.
 
 
 
• **Global vaccination challenges:**
 
 
• Factors such as vaccine hesitancy, lack of access, and geopolitical instability contribute to unvaccinated populations worldwide.
 
• The COVID-19 pandemic further disrupted vaccination programs, exacerbating the problem.
 
 
 
• **The role of The Lancet:**
 
 
• The Lancet is a leading medical journal providing data and analysis on global health issues, including vaccination coverage.
 
• Its reports often guide policy-making and international health interventions.

questions.question: What is India's rank in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2024, and which country has topped the list?

options.text: India's rank is 96th, and Denmark topped the list
India's rank is 96th, and Finland topped the list
India's rank is 93rd, and Denmark topped the list
India's rank is 93rd, and Finland topped the list

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India's rank is 96th, and Denmark topped the list.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India ranks 96th with a score of 38 in the CPI 2024, while Denmark has topped the list with a score of 90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's rank dropped to 96th with a score of 38 in 2024, down from 93rd in 2023.**
 
• Denmark remains at the top of the CPI list for the seventh consecutive year with a score of 90.
 
• The global average CPI score is 43, with more than two-thirds of countries scoring below 50, indicating significant corruption levels.
 
• South Sudan, Somalia, and Venezuela are among the worst performers in the CPI 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• CPI (Corruption Perceptions Index)__

 __
 
• The CPI is released by **Transparency International **and ranks countries based on perceived levels of public sector corruption.
 
• The index uses a scale of 0 (high corruption) to 100 (low corruption).
 
 
 
• Top and Bottom Performers__
 __
 
• Denmark has been the top performer for seven consecutive years with a score of 90 in 2024.
 
• South Sudan, Somalia, and Venezuela are ranked at the bottom of the index.
 
 
 
• India's Performance__
 __
 
• India ranks 96th with a score of 38, which reflects a decline in its position from 2023 (93rd) and 2022 (40th).
 
 
 
• **Regional Comparison (South Asia)**__
 
 
• China: Rank 76, Score 42
 
• Sri Lanka: Rank 121, Score 32
 
• Pakistan: Rank 135, Score 27
 
• Bangladesh: Rank 149, Score 23
 
• Afghanistan: Rank 165, Score 17

questions.question: Which institution released the Global Terrorism Index (GTI) 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP) released the Global Terrorism Index (GTI) 2025, ranking Pakistan as the second-most terrorism-affected country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The GTI ranks countries based on terrorism-related indicators like attacks, fatalities, and injuries.**
 
• **India is ranked 14th in the Global Terrorism Index (GTI) 2025.**
 
• The 2025 GTI reported a 45% increase in terrorism-related fatalities in Pakistan, making it the second-most terrorism-affected country.
 
• The TTP (Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan) was identified as the deadliest group responsible for a significant number of deaths in Pakistan.
 
• IEP is an independent, non-profit think tank that focuses on global peace and the economic impacts of violence and terrorism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)__

 __
 
• IEP is a global think tank that provides data and research on issues related to peace, conflict, and the economic impact of violence and terrorism.
 
• IEP's Global Terrorism Index (GTI) is one of the most comprehensive reports used to rank countries based on terrorism and its impact.
 
 
 
• TTP (Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan)__
 __
 
• TTP is a militant group based in Pakistan that has carried out numerous attacks against civilians and military personnel, making it one of the deadliest terrorist organizations in Pakistan.
 
• In 2024, TTP was responsible for 52% of the terrorism-related deaths in Pakistan.
 
 
 
• Global Terrorism Index (GTI)__
 
 
• The GTI ranks countries based on terrorism-related data including the frequency of attacks, fatalities, injuries, and other impacts on society.
 
• IEP’s GTI is used by governments and organizations worldwide to gauge the severity of terrorism in different regions.

questions.question: Which country is the most polluted in 2024 and what is India's rank as per the recently revealed 2024 Air Pollution Rankings by IQAir?

options.text: Democratic Republic of Congo, India at 4th

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chad and India's Rank is 5th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Chad is the most polluted country in 2024__, with pollution levels over 15 times higher than WHO guidelines.**
 
• **__India ranks fifth in global pollution rankings__, with Byrnihat being the most polluted city in India, registering a PM2.5 level of 128 mg/cu m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chad has the highest pollution levels in 2024, exceeding WHO guidelines by more than 15 times.**
 
• India ranks fifth in global pollution levels with an average PM2.5 level of 50.6 mg/cu m in 2024.
 
• Byrnihat, an industrialized city in India's northeast, recorded the highest PM2.5 level of 128 mg/cu m in the country.
 
• Climate change is increasing the pollution levels due to higher temperatures and prolonged forest fires, impacting various regions globally.
 
• Swiss company IQAir’s 2024 World Air Quality Report revealed this.
 
• **India was 5th in the smog rankings behind Chad, Bangladesh, Pakistan & Democratic Republic of Congo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM2.5:__ A measure of fine particulate matter in the air, less than 2.5 micrometers in diameter, which can be hazardous to health.
 
• __WHO Guidelines:__ World Health Organization's recommended safe levels for air quality, which is set at a maximum of 5 micrograms per cubic meter for PM2.5.
 
• __Byrnihat:__ A city in the northeastern part of India known for its industrial activity, contributing to high pollution levels.
 
• __Climate Change:__ A major driver of increased pollution, with higher temperatures fueling more intense and prolonged forest fires, which in turn increases air pollution levels.

questions.question: What is the percentage increase in India's social security coverage from 2021 to 2024, as reported in the World Social Protection Report prepared by the International Labour Organization?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**24.4% to 48.8%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India's social security coverage has doubled, reaching 48.8% in 2024, up from 24.4% in 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's social security coverage has doubled from 24.4% in 2021 to 48.8% in 2024, as per the World Social Protection Report.**
 
• This progress is attributed to key government welfare programs such as Ayushman Bharat, the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana, and the Atal Pension Yojana.
 
• These programs have expanded access to health insurance, food security, pensions, and employment support across India.
 
• The ILO's report highlights India's crucial role in global welfare outcomes due to this significant increase in coverage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• World Social Protection Report__

 __
 
• Annual report by the International Labour Organization (ILO) evaluating social security systems worldwide.
 
• The 2024–26 edition focuses on universal social protection, climate action, and just transition.
 
 
 
• Ayushman Bharat__
 __
 
• India's flagship health insurance scheme offers coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family.
 
• Provides health services across a large network of empaneled hospitals.
 
 
 
• Atal Pension Yojana__
 
 
• Scheme providing financial security for the unorganized sector by offering pension benefits to subscribers.
 
• Targets long-term financial security, with a total corpus of ₹43,369.98 crore as of December 2024.

• India’s latest Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) data was released by the Registrar-General of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Maternal Death:** Occurs during pregnancy or within 42 days of pregnancy termination, from pregnancy-related causes.

 
 
• 
 
**Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR):** Number of maternal deaths per **100,000 live births**.

 
 
• 
 
**India’s MMR (2019–21):** **93**, improved from **97 (2018–20)** and **103 (2017–19)**.

 
 
• 
 
**UN SDG Target:** Reduce global MMR to **below 70** per 100,000 live births.

 
 
• 
 
**High-Risk Age Groups:**

 
 
• 
 
**Highest MMR:** Age **20–29**

 
 
• 
 
**Second highest:** Age **30–34**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**States with High MMRs:**

**Madhya Pradesh (175)**

**Odisha (135)**

 
 
•

• 
 
**West Bengal (109)**

 
 
• 
 
**Haryana (106)**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Data Source:** **Sample Registration System (SRS)**, one of India’s largest demographic surveys, managed by the **Registrar-General of India**.

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Jharkhand, Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Fiscal Health Index 2025: Mapping India's State-Level Economic Resilience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Purpose of FHI:** The Fiscal Health Index (FHI) by NITI Aayog aims to assess the fiscal health of Indian states, based on their contribution to GDP, demography, public expenditure, revenues, and fiscal stability.

 
 
• 
 
**Leading States:** Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Jharkhand, and Gujarat lead the Fiscal Health Index as of the latest report.

 
 
• 
 
**States’ Role in Economy:** States are responsible for about two-thirds of public spending and one-third of total revenue, making their fiscal performance crucial for India's overall economic stability.

 
 
• 
 
**Data Source:** The FHI is developed using data from the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) for the financial year 2022-23.

 
 
• 
 
**Debt Sustainability:** Focuses on the state's ability to meet both current and future debt obligations without defaulting, considering both solvency and liquidity.

 
 
• 
 
**Debt Index:** The Debt Index is the ratio of Interest Payments to Revenue Receipts (IP/RR), indicating the percentage of revenue spent on servicing debt.

 
 
• 
 
**Fiscal Health Evaluation:** The FHI provides a composite index to objectively evaluate each state's fiscal health, enabling comparisons with best practices and other states.

questions.question: According to the 26th edition of the "Women and Men in India 2024" report, the labour force participation rate in usual status for individuals aged 15 and above increased to what percentage in 2023–24?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**60.1%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **In April 2025, the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released the 26th edition of its publication “Women and Men in India 2024: Selected Indicators and Data.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The labour force participation rate in usual status for individuals aged 15 years and above increased to **60.1%** in 2023–24.
 
• This marks a significant rise from **49.8%** recorded in 2017–18.
 
• The data reflects growing economic engagement across genders.
 
• Findings are based on indicators sourced from various Ministries, Departments, and Organizations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Women and Men in India 2024__

 __
 
• 26th edition of the gender-based statistical publication by MoSPI.
 
• Covers key areas such as population, health, education, labour, and decision-making.
 
 
 
• Gender Parity Index (GPI)__
 __
 
• Primary and higher secondary education levels show consistently high GPI.
 
• Indicates near parity or higher female enrolment at these levels.
 
 
 
• Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)__
 
 
• Refers to the percentage of people aged 15 and above who are working or actively seeking work.
 
• Increase in LFPR reflects improved economic engagement and employment outreach.

questions.question: Which organization publishes the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), which reported a 2.9% growth in February 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Statistical Office.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IIP growth rate slowed to 2.9% in February 2025, the slowest in six months, according to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is published by the National Statistical Office (NSO)__.**
 
• **IIP tracks manufacturing activity across various sectors and is a key economic indicator.**
 
• **Base year for IIP calculation is .**
 
• **IIP includes 8 core industries which constitute __40.27%__ of the index.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Statistical Office (NSO)**__

 __
 
• It is a part of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
• It publishes key statistical data including GDP, IIP, CPI, etc.
 
 
 
• **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)**__
 __
 
• Conducts large-scale surveys on socio-economic topics.
 
• Now merged into NSO after reorganization.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**__
 __
 
• Think tank of the Government of India that provides directional and policy inputs.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Heavy Industries**__
 
 
• Deals with development of capital goods and automobile sector.
